title: Aurelius
description: A vanilla + mod making more blocks and items renewable, while also adding some QOL improvements.
body:
Aurelius is a vanilla QOL mod I made to make minecraft more fun to play for myself.
It includes some backports of features not yet included in Vanilla Backport, some new recipes for vanilla items, and some vanilla+ features to redious the number of tedious actions from the game.
Here are some of the features:

## Backports
### Items
- Copper Tools
- Copper Armor
- Copper Horse Armor
- Netherite Horse Armor
### Recipes
- Lead
- Saddle
- Bundle

## QOL Vanilla improvements
### Pets
- Pets no longer take damage from their owner (Configurable through commands)
- Pets respawn after sleeping (Configurable through commands)

### Recipes
- Copper Horse Armor
- Iron Horse Armor
- Golden Horse Armor
- Diamond Horse Armor
- New way to craft netherite items from diamond items (blaze power replacing the netherite upgrade)
- New stairs recipe
- Nametag
- Sponge
- Raw Ore Blocks can be smelted using the blasting furnace
- Rotten flesh can be smelted for leather

### Loot Tables
- Bookshelf, Campfire, Enderchest, Sea Lantern, Campfire and Soul Campfire now drops when broken.

## New Mobs, Blocks And Items
### Mobs
Toretoise, a tamable mob spawning in caves. It grows a random ore on its back and can be tamed by any of this ore's family of item.
They're immune to fire and lava.

The Rotten Flesh Golem, made with:
- one rotten flesh block
- any crimson heart on top
- another rotten flesh block on top
- a bone block on each side of the heart.
  This golem has more hps when summoned using a boosted crimson heart

### Blocks
- Rotten Flesh Block
- Lava Sponge
- Netherrack Furnace (Infinite furnace, can be boosted using combustible)
- Crimson Pumpkin
- Crimson Heart (And Boosted Crimson Heart)
- Glow Torch (Underwater Torch)

### Items
- Netherrack Tools
- Counter
- Quill (No exp nametag renaming, need to be charged with ink every 64 uses)
- Retoor (Allay transportation item)
- Toasted Bread
- Baked Carrot
- Spawn Eggs
